findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Observed coffee nozzles to be soiled with food debris. PIC was informed of accumulation and the nozzles were cleaned. Ensure staff are thoroughly cleaned frequently enough to avoid accumulation.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition.
findings.comment: Observed hot dogs and brats in the back cooler to be opened with no date mark. There is a system in place which automatically prints a date marking label when the package is opened. It seems these two packages were simply missed. PIC was informed and will educate staff on proper date marking. Ensure staff are placing date marking labels on packages after opening to prevent the sale of out-of-date products.
findings.citation_text: 3-501.17(A) Ready-to-Eat, Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Date Marking. (A) Except when PACKAGING FOOD using a REDUCED OXYGEN PACKAGING method as specified under § 3-502.12, and except as specified in (E) and (F) of this section, refrigerated, READY-TO-EAT, TIME/TEMPERATURE CONTROL FOR SAFETY FOOD prepared and held in a FOOD ESTABLISHMENT for more than 24 hours shall be clearly marked to indicate the date or day by which the FOOD shall be consumed on the PREMISES, sold, or discarded when held at a temperature of 5C (41F) or less for a maximum of 7 days. The day of preparation shall be counted as Day 1.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
Observed no paper towels available for use at hand washing sink in back room. Towels were provided during inspection. 

6-301.12: Each HANDWASHING SINK shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels; (B) A continuous towel system that supplies the user with a clean towel; (C) A heated-air hand drying device; (D) A hand drying device that employs an air-knife system that delivers high velocity, pressurized air at ambient temperatures.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
Observed interior cavity of customer microwave under hot dog roller to be soiled with food splash and debris. Clean and sanitize inside cavity of customer microwave. 

4-602.12: (A) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking and baking EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at least every 24 hours. This section does not apply to hot oil cooking and filtering EQUIPMENT if it is cleaned as specified in Subparagraph 4-602.11(D)(6). (B) The cavities and door seals of microwave ovens shall be cleaned at least every 24 hours by using the manufacturer's recommended cleaning procedure.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Observed front floors of display cooler to be soiled with refuse. Clean floors of display cooler. 

6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.comment:
Observed facility to not have a certified food protection manager on duty during inspection when food was being served. CFPM must be present at facility at all times of food preparation and service. 

2-102.12: (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
Observed bottle of multi-purpose cleaner in basin of hand washing sink in back room. Bottle was removed during inspection. 

5-205.11: (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
Observed interior cavity of customer microwave under hot dog roller to be soiled with food splash and debris. Clean and sanitize inside cavity of customer microwave. 

4-602.12: (A) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking and baking EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at least every 24 hours. This section does not apply to hot oil cooking and filtering EQUIPMENT if it is cleaned as specified in Subparagraph 4-602.11(D)(6). (B) The cavities and door seals of microwave ovens shall be cleaned at least every 24 hours by using the manufacturer's recommended cleaning procedure.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
Observed racks that hold disposable drink lids to be soiled with dust and soil debris. Clean and sanitize disposable drink lid racks.

4-602.11: (D) FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES shall be cleaned less than every 4 hours if in storage of food within proper temperatures, food is prepared in refrigerated room, if practice has regulatory approval, or UTENSILS stored in 135F water. (E) Surfaces of UTENSILS and EQUIPMENT contacting food shall be cleaned any time contamination occurs, at least 24 hours for certain UTENSILS (i.e. iced tea dispensers), before restocking self-service EQUIPMENT, in EQUIPMENT such as ice bins in frequency to prevent mold. At a frequency to preclude accumulation of soil or mold.

findings.title: In-use utensils: properly stored
findings.comment:
Observed tongs used for hot dog roller to be stored on a metal projection attached to the roller machine. Tongs may become contaminated each time tongs are removed and replaced from metal projection. Store tongs on a clean food-contact surface. 

3-304.12: FOOD preparation and dispensing UTENSILS shall be stored: (A) in FOOD with their handles above top of FOOD and container (B) In non-TCS FOOD (C) On clean portion of FOOD preparation table or cooking EQUIPMENT as long as UTENSIL cleaned with proper frequency (Time/Temp Control Form). (D) In running water with sufficient velocity (E) In clean, protected location if UTENSILS are used only for FOOD not TCS (F) In container of water at least 135F and container is properly cleaned.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Observed area in back room around grease interceptor and CO2 dispenser to be soiled with liquid and paper debris. Clean area around grease interceptor and CO2 dispenser. 

6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment: 4-601.11: Observed some soda nozzles and the ice dispenser to be soiled. The manager stated these surfaces would be cleaned immediately to correct the violation. Ensure these surfaces are cleaned frequently so they are maintained clean. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment: 5-205.11  (Pf) Hand washing sink blocked by a cleaning brush and the mop bucket. Hand washing sinks must be accessible at all times. Reference 5-205.11. Mop bucket and brush werew removed from the hand sink and area in front of the hand sink. Do not block hand sink even though the sink rarely used.
findings.citation_text: 6-301.11  (Pf) Liquid hand soap not provided at the hand washing sink in back room. Provide liquid soap at hand washing sink. Reference 6-301.11. Hand soap was provided to the sink in back room.

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures
findings.citation_text: 3-501.16(A)(2) and (B)  (P) Foods stored in the walk in cooler read between 45°F and 50°F. Also Pico in the condiment cold holder is  45°F.  Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food (TCS) is not maintained at 41°F, or less. Reviewed cold holding requirements and discussed HACCP concept with employee and person in charge. Inadequately held food was discarded. Reference 3-501.16(A)(2) and (B). Do not store TCS foods in coolers that are unable to maintain them at safe internal temperature of 41°F or below. Call when repair is complete.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition
findings.citation_text: 3-501.17  (Pf) Date marking is not on the foods in the walk in cooler including pico and various brats and hot dogs. Also Pico in the condiment cold holder is not date marked. This item may be turned over every 24 hours or sooner.  Food shall be clearly marked, at the time the original container is opened in a food establishment and if the food is held for more than 24 hours, to indicate the date or day by which the food shall be consumed on the premises, sold, or discarded, when held at a temperature of 41°F  or less for a maximum of 7 days (not exceeding a manufacturer's use-by date). Discussed applicable sections of 3-501.17 and reviewed HACCP concepts with person in charge. Food was discarded. Reference 3-501.17. These foods were the same foods that were discarded due to temperature.

findings.title: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control
findings.citation_text: 4-301.11  (Pf) Food establishment does not have food cooling equipment with adequate capacity for current operations. Provide equipment for cooling food, and holding cold food, that is sufficient in number and capacity to cool food rapidly to required temperatures within the required timeframes. Discussed HACCP concept with the person in charge. Reference 4-301.11. The walk in cooler is being repaired as it is frozen according to the technician woking on it. Do not store TCS foods in the walk in unit until it is repaired and able to hold TCS foods safely.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.citation_text: 4-602.13  (C) Soil residue present on: 1) the counters between the soda machine and the cup holder, 2) in the soda machine drip tray especially around the tubes 3) the counters between the coffee pots and cap machine 4) . Clean all non-food contact surfaces frequently to prevent soil accumulation.  Reference 4-602.13.
